reproduction.rationale: Both conditions must receive identical original food/SWR observations and panel identities, with only the four official author MATLAB files added to +code. The existing A/B detector-2 archive package is not the full original panel. No authenticated original-panel common manifest, independent verifier, source-derived output identities, exposure policy or cumulative budgets can yet bind a protocol.

improvement.rationale: The preserved improvement contract is ineligible because larger physiological effects or smaller p-values do not define method superiority. No matching improvement evaluator or paired protocol is invented; any later scientifically valid endpoint must preserve the same original task and observations rather than substitute prediction or archive fidelity.
